sentences.en: They're a little smaller. Like this big. You got it. Anything to drink?
sentences.tc: 它們有點小。像這麼大的。你明白了。有什麼喝的嗎？

sentences.en: We have Sprite, Fanta, Coke, Pepsi, and Dr. Pepper. Sure thing. Small or large? All right. So, that's one double cheeseburger, large fries, and a large Coke. Anything else? Of course.
sentences.tc: 我們有雪碧、芬達、可口可樂、百事可樂和胡椒博士。當然可以。小還是大？好的。所以，這是一個雙層起司漢堡、大薯條和一大杯可樂。還要別的嗎？當然。

sentences.en: Would you like cheese on the bacon as well? Or just the regular double cheeseburger with bacon? No problem?
sentences.tc: 您想在培根上加起司嗎？還是只是普通的雙層起司漢堡加培根？沒問題？

sentences.en: Would you like everything on it? comes with lettuce, tomato, pickles, onion, and ketchup. You got it. No onions. Anything else?
sentences.tc: 你想要上面的一切嗎？附有生菜、番茄、泡菜、洋蔥和番茄醬。你明白了。沒有洋蔥。還要別的嗎？

sentences.tc: 我想向你們展示一下。

sentences.en: My favorite place to learn new things. I always say never stop learning, right? And with Skillshare,.
sentences.tc: 我最喜歡學習新事物的地方。我總是說永遠不要停止學習，對嗎？並透過技能分享，。

sentences.en: You will never stop learning. I'm so excited that this video is sponsored by Skillshare. I've been using Skillshare for a few years now and I'm constantly learning new skills with it.
sentences.tc: 你永遠不會停止學習。我很高興該影片由 Skillshare 贊助。我已經使用 Skillshare 幾年了，並且不斷地用它學習新技能。

sentences.en: From languages to drawing to learning how to organize my ideas better. In a world.
sentences.tc: 從語言到繪畫，再到學習如何更好地組織我的想法。在一個世界裡。

sentences.en: I love how clearly.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡多麼清晰。

sentences.en: He shows us all the phrases.

sentences.en: Then naturally as you would in a real life conversation.

sentences.en: What are you doing? Shouldn't I?

sentences.en: He talks about so many important topics for ESL learners.

sentences.en: We pronounce cat? Cat or pack? P pack. That's a cat.
sentences.tc: 我們發音貓？貓還是包包？ P包。那是一隻貓。

sentences.en: He explains it all. Connected speech crucial for intermediate learners. who want to improve their pronunciation.
sentences.tc: 他解釋了這一切。互聯語音對於中級學習者至關重要。想要提升發音的人。

sentences.tc: 我想你會在這堂課學到很多。這就是為什麼我很高興與 Skillshare 合作。
